title: Contract the entire weighted H1 preparation ball with one fixed path
statement: Let a=(1+kappa²)^-1/2,b=(1+2kappa²)^-1/2,Q1=I-P1. Then JP1=aP1,||JQ1||<=b,b/a<3/4. Forward and adjoint remainder estimates bound ||W(s*)J|| by the norm of the2-by-2 nonnegative block matrix with entries a(1-cs*^4+r),br; ar,b exp(3696s*). At s*=2^-400,r<=s*^4,exp(3696s*)<9/8,c>432,so the second diagonal stays below27a/32 while the first is near a. Bounding the remaining perturbation gives ||W(s*)J||<=a(1-430s*^4)<=a(1-100s*^4). Thus ONE fixed rational path decreases the worst-case norm over the ENTIRE infinite-dimensional H1 ball,including input tails and backflow. It is not a menu or input-dependent path. Higher-mode L2 amplification prevents direct iteration of this weighted estimate.
